title: Expose navigable scientific evidence provenance in Research
root_cause: Evidence rows showed only a generic source label and value, obscuring the persisted field, Artifact, ToolCall and checksum chain.

change.behavior: Research evidence disclosures now show a bounded provenance summary containing field locator, Artifact ID, ToolCall ID and SHA-256 when available.

assertions: Scientific values remain sourced from existing evidence items.
No credentials, provider prompts or infrastructure secrets are exposed.
